name: Sakurashita Yuuko
source:
Namiaki Academy Class 2-C. A member of the 4K Club. Sits diagonally behind the protagonist.

A gentle and soothing type of girl with a somewhat mysterious aura.
Although she has a likable personality that appeals to everyone, she tends to blend into the background in class and doesn’t have many friends.

Her only close friend is Otoha.
She seems to half-believe in ghosts.
For some reason, she was reluctant about the protagonist joining the 4K Club.
Due to her weak physical condition, she does not participate in physical education classes.
Even in summer, she always wears tights.
translation:
波见秋学园2年C班。4K部成员。座位在主人公斜后方。

她是温柔治愈型女孩，带着某种神秘气息。

她性格讨人喜欢，能吸引所有人，却常在班级里融入背景，朋友不多。

她唯一亲密的朋友是乙叶。她似乎半信半疑地相信鬼魂。

不知为何，她不太愿意让主人公加入4K部。

由于身体虚弱，她不参加体育课。即使在夏天，她也总是穿着紧身裤。
